Benedictine Spread
By: Amy Jeanroy
Published: Tuesday, April 26, 2016 - 9:20pm

Ingredients




1 8 ounce package cream cheese
1 Tbsp mayonaise
3 Tbsp grated and drained cucumber
1 tsp green onion tops (Chives work well here)
1 drop food coloring (optional)

Preparation

1 Blend all ingredients well 2 Spread on crackers or crustless bread triangles

About

Cream cheese and cucumber make up this classy must-have spread for Derby Day. Don't let the calendar stop you though. It's a great tasting sandwich spread any time of year.
